definition: the one hard date night run so far, read off the record the day after

settled:
One hard night has been run so far, so the cost is not fixed. It took about six hours, and we had to push through the hard to reach the change on the far side.

It did not reach the subject it was for. We went sideways into the subjects that were blocking us, and those are what resolved.

The cost lands the day after rather than during. Both nights were entered at level four.

After the hard night I sat at level one for nine hours and was back to four by the next mid-morning, about thirty-nine hours. After hers I went down to two and was back to four the following afternoon, about twenty-two hours.

So the hard night costs roughly twice what hers does, and neither came near the sub-zero line.
